notes.title: New build pushed coinciding with release of sequel "TAAM: Bring the Thunder"
notes.notes:
A new build for There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst has just been set live to coincide with the release of the next game in the series There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder (just released right now).



This new build of TAAM: DYW fixes a few bugs and updates the call-to-action at end of game to purchase the next game of TAAM: BTT (as opposed to wishlisting the next game, which was the previous call-to-action).



Although each game in the There's Always a Madman series is a standalone adventure for secret agents Franklin Benjamin and Virginia West, all three released games are on discount right now for the Steam Summer Sale.



There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight



There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst



There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder



With the release of the third entry, now is the best time to catch up on the entire series (with all three released games currently on discount).  And the fourth and fifth entries are available to wishlist on Steam now as well!



There's Always a Madman: The MacGuffin



There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.



Best of luck agent - because there's always a madman, and you're the best agent we've got!
